limits.conditions: absolute maximum rating
limits.note: The module, not the board. ESP32-WROOM-32 datasheet v3.8, Table 12 Absolute Maximum Ratings (p. 26): Ioutput, cumulative IO output current max 1,100 mA (the bare ESP32 chip datasheet, Table 5-1 p. 51, gives 1,200 mA).

limits.conditions: board limit
limits.note: Board limit, not the regulator's: the DevKitC V4 schematic's input capacitor C1 is 22 uF/10 V, below the AMS1117's 15 V absolute maximum input (p. 2, the cited source). 10 V is the lower of the two.

typical.note: chip, not board. Table 5-4 (p. 52): Wi-Fi receive 802.11b/g/n 95 ~ 100 mA typ (upper end taken), 3.3 V, 25 C. With the radio off, Modem-sleep at 240 MHz dual-core is 30 ~ 68 mA (Table 4-2, p. 30). Excludes the USB-UART bridge and LEDs (see unaccounted).

peak.note: Wi-Fi transmit 802.11b, DSSS 1 Mbps, POUT = +19.5 dBm: 240 mA typ, Table 5-4 (p. 52), 3.3 V, 25 C, measured at 50 % duty cycle; chip, not board.

minVolts.note: ESP32-WROOM-32 module, Table 13 Recommended Operating Conditions (p. 26): VDD33 min 3.0 V. The module, not the board.

vf.note: D3 on the DevKitC V4 schematic is a BAT760-7 (Diodes Inc.), VBUS to EXT_5V. Electrical Characteristics (p. 2): forward voltage typ 320 mV at IF = 100 mA (max 350 mV; typ 495 mV at 1 A), 25 C. 100 mA is near the board's typical load.

vout.note: AMS1117-3.3 (U2 on the DevKitC V4 schematic). Electrical Characteristics (p. 2): output voltage 3.300 V typ (3.251 to 3.349 V at 25 C).

dropout.note: Electrical Characteristics (p. 3): dropout typ 1.1 V (max 1.3 V) at IOUT = 0.8 A, delta VOUT = 1 %. The only point the datasheet gives; at the board's 0.1 to 0.3 A the real dropout is likely lower (no curve given).

ioutMax.note: Every load specification (load regulation, dropout, Note 4) is stated up to 0.8 A, and the current limit is min 0.9 A (p. 3); p. 1 headlines "output current of 1A", which the guaranteed limit does not cover.

iq.note: Quiescent current typ 5 mA (max 11 mA) at VIN - VOUT = 1.5 V, Electrical Characteristics p. 3.

outputResistance.note: Linear approximation at the default drive strength 2 (~20 mA; the datasheet notes on the pin list give 0: ~5, 1: ~10, 2: ~20, 3: ~40 mA, default 2). Table 5-3 (p. 52) at the maximum strength: high (3.3 - 2.64 V) / 40 mA = 16.5 ohm, low 0.495 V / 28 mA = 17.7 ohm, about 17 ohm; halving the strength roughly doubles it, about 34 ohm. A pin set to strength 3 is nearer 17 ohm. Chip, not board.

pullup.note: chip, not board. Table 5-3 (p. 52) RPU typ 45 kohm, 3.3 V, 25 C.

pulldown.note: chip, not board. Table 5-3 (p. 52) RPD typ 45 kohm, 3.3 V, 25 C.

inputLeakage.note: chip, not board. Table 5-3 (p. 52) IIH / IIL max 50 nA, 3.3 V, 25 C.

notes: Board schematic: Espressif ESP32_DevKitc_V4 Rev V4 (2017-12-06), https://dl.espressif.com/dl/schematics/esp32_devkitc_v4-sch.pdf. Power: micro-USB VBUS through D3 BAT760-7 to EXT_5V (the 5V header pin); U2 AMS1117-3.3 from EXT_5V to VDD33 (C1 22 uF/10 V in, C3 22 uF/10 V out).
LDO reverse is "body-diode": the AMS1117 datasheet (Protection Diodes, p. 4) describes an internal diode between the input and output pins.
USB diode reverse is "blocks": D3 is a Schottky from VBUS to EXT_5V (reverse leakage typ 3.0 uA at 5 V, BAT760 p. 2).
Module: D2 ESP-WROOM-32 on the schematic (the WROVER footprint U3 is marked NC); later DevKitC V4 boards ship WROOM-32D/32U/32E or WROVER variants, not re-checked per variant here.

GPIO pins: every header GPIO except the flash lines. VP (GPIO36), VN (GPIO39), IO34, IO35 are input-only, so they carry no current limit. Left out: CLK, CMD, D0, D1, D2, D3 (GPIO6 to 11, the module's SPI flash, not usable as GPIO), EN, power, ground, USB.

Board parts on GPIO pins that this format cannot hold: TX/RX tied to the CP2102N through R17/R18 0 ohm; IO0 and EN driven by the auto-program transistors Q1/Q2 (SS8050) from DTR/RTS; R11 10 kohm EN to VDD33.
Per-pin current limits use the datasheet drive figures (IOH/IOL), the only per-pin current numbers Espressif gives; they are rated drive, not absolute maximum.
unaccounted: CP2102N USB-UART bridge (U1), VDD and REGIN on VDD33: no idle current on the schematic and no measurement.

Red power LED D1 + R2 2 kohm from EXT_5V (the 5V domain) to GND: the schematic gives the resistor, not the current (roughly (5 V - LED Vf) / 2 kohm, about 1.4 to 1.6 mA for a red LED Vf of 1.8 to 2.2 V, LED part unknown).
VBUS sense divider R25 22.1 kohm + R26 47.5 kohm from VBUS to GND: about 5 V / 69.6 kohm = 72 uA on the USB domain (arithmetic from the schematic, not modelled).
Module extras beyond the chip (SPI flash, crystal): the draw values are the chip's.

corrected.why: The board carries an ESP32-WROOM-32 module (schematic), and its own datasheet (v3.8, Table 12 Absolute Maximum Ratings, p. 26) gives cumulative IO output current max 1,100 mA, below the bare chip's 1,200 mA; the part on the board takes precedence. Source and note changed to the module datasheet.
